title: Arsenal Zero, my browser idle game: AI-generated buildings that snap onto the base
author: Professional-Emu4891
selftext:
I make Arsenal Zero, a free idle military looter in the browser. I just added the hideout: you build a workshop, scrapyard, foundry, defense post and merchant on your base.

My first AI-generated base had pads that were all slightly different, so every building needed its own tweaks. I remade it with five identical pads, then generated each building directly on a pad with OpenAI's image edit. Now any building fits any pad, nothing to adjust.

Code is AI-assisted with Claude Code. Video shows the buildings going up.

Do you generate your maps in one piece, or build them from parts?

[arsenalzero.com](https://arsenalzero.com/?utm_source=reddit&utm_campaign=aigamedev_planque)

comments.author: WWEtrump
comments.body: buildings snapping onto the base is so satisfying to watch. the idle loop with the base growing looks really clean. i'm working on an armored truck that unfolds into a base building so this hit close to home. did you have a hard time making the snap feel weighty?
